# Toxic Valley Treasure Maps: Rewards Data Mining & All Locations

![Toxic Valley Treasure Maps: Rewards Data Mining & All Locations](/uploads/504_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![MonaLisa](/public/avatar_MonaLisa_ml1080.png) 

Treasure maps show **locations** with buried supplies in the game. To find the location, the **treasure map** must be in your inventory. The more treasure cards you have in your inventory for a location, the more can be dug up at the same time.

Treasure maps have **no carrying weight** and can therefore be stored in large quantities in the inventory. Supplies that can be unearthed include: **Weapons, Armor, Mods, Blueprints, Scrap, Chems, Food.**

In addition to the treasure maps and locations, there is also **data mining** with the possible rewards per area, as well as general rewards and rewards for teammates.

### Index

## Toxic Valley treasure maps

### Toxic Valley Treasure Map 01

The hill with the treasure is west of the Becker farm next to a dilapidated wooden shack.

### Toxic Valley Treasure Map 02

West of Clarksburg on a hill behind the water tower is the hill with the treasure.

### Toxic Valley Treasure Map 03

Travel to the Boy Scout Pioneer Camp. In the middle of the lake, on the small island with a boat, is the hill with the treasure.

### Toxic Valley Treasure Map 04

From fast travel and the Crater entrance, run to the rocks. On a ledge is the hill with the treasure.
